cases.title: Select available seat and update count and total price
cases.description: Verify that clicking on any available seat (without the occupied class) marks it as selected, updates the selected seat count in the element with data-testid="selected-count", and updates the total price in data-testid="total-price".

cases.title: Select movie from dropdown to update ticket price and total price
cases.description: Verify that selecting a movie from data-testid="movie-select" updates the ticket price, and changing the selected movie at any time updates the total price accordingly based on the number of selected seats.

cases.title: Prevent occupied seats from being selectable and affecting calculations
cases.description: Verify that seats marked as occupied are not selectable and do not affect the seat count or total price.

cases.title: Select movie from dropdown
cases.description: Verify that users can select a movie from the dropdown menu, with options like 'The Big Lebowski ($10)', 'Fargo ($12)', 'O Brother ($8)', and 'No Country for Old Men ($9)', each identified by a specific data-testid, and its price updates accordingly.

cases.title: Toggle available seat selection and update storage
cases.description: Verify that clicking on an available seat (e.g., identified by data-testid="seat-1-1") toggles the seat's selection status, visually marks the seat as selected, and stores its index in localStorage.

cases.title: Dynamically update seat count and total price
cases.description: Verify that the seat count (data-testid="selected-count") and total price (data-testid="total-price") are dynamically updated based on the number of selected seats and the chosen movie's price.

cases.title: Prevent selection of occupied seats
cases.description: Verify that seats marked as 'occupied' cannot be selected or included in the calculation.

cases.title: Deselect previously selected seats
cases.description: Verify that users can deselect previously selected seats by clicking on them again, and that the UI, along with localStorage, updates accordingly.

cases.title: Restore Saved State From Local Storage
cases.description: Upon page load, if local storage contains keys 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex', the system marks the corresponding seats with the 'selected' class and sets the movie dropdown to the saved movie index.

cases.title: Default State Without Local Storage
cases.description: Upon page load, if local storage does not contain 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex', no seats are marked as 'selected' and the dropdown defaults to the first movie option 'The Big Lebowski ($10)'.

cases.title: Select Movie and Set Ticket Price
cases.description: Verify that when the user selects a movie from the dropdown menu with data-testid 'movie-select', the ticket price is set according to the selected movie's value.

cases.title: Toggle Seat Selection
cases.description: Verify that as the user clicks on available seats (those without the 'occupied' class) within the seating area, the system toggles the 'selected' class on the clicked seat.

cases.title: Update Selected Seat Count
cases.description: Verify that the count of selected seats, displayed with data-testid 'selected-count', updates to reflect the current number of seats with the 'selected' class.

cases.title: Calculate Total Price
cases.description: Verify that the total price, displayed with data-testid 'total-price', is calculated as the product of the number of selected seats and the current ticket price.

cases.title: Deselect Seat
cases.description: Verify that if a user deselects a seat by clicking on it again, the count and total price decrease accordingly.

cases.title: Update Total Price on Movie Change with Existing Selection
cases.description: Verify that if the user changes the movie selection after selecting seats, the total price updates based on the new ticket price while maintaining the count of selected seats.

cases.title: Prevent Selection of Occupied Seats
cases.description: Verify that the system prevents users from selecting seats marked as 'occupied'.

cases.title: Display status legends and seat states
cases.description: Verify that legends including data-testid='seat-select' are present on the Movie Seat Booking page to help users distinguish between available, selected, and occupied seats.

cases.title: Non-interactive occupied seats
cases.description: Verify that seats marked as occupied are non-interactive and clearly marked to prevent selection.

cases.title: Toggle selection on available seats
cases.description: Verify that available seats can be clicked to toggle their selection state.

cases.title: Update count and price on seat selection or deselection
cases.description: Verify that when users select or deselect seats, the count of selected seats and the total price are updated accordingly.

opinions.feedback: The proposed test cases adequately cover the requirements for the movie seat booking application, including seat selection, movie dropdown interactions, pricing calculations, local storage persistence, and legend states. No blockers or redundant cases were found.

analysis.analysis: R-1 contains multiple distinct behaviors: interacting with the seat map to update the total price, clicking available seats to mark them as selected, updating the selected seat count in data-testid="selected-count", selecting a movie from data-testid="movie-select", calculating total price in data-testid="total-price", preventing occupied seats from being selectable, and updating total price upon changing selected movies. R-2 contains multiple distinct behaviors: selecting a movie from the dropdown, updating the movie price, clicking available seats to toggle selection status, visually marking selected seats, storing seat indices in localStorage, dynamically updating seat count and total price, preventing occupied seat selection and calculation, and deselecting seats by clicking again with UI and localStorage updates. R-3 contains multiple distinct behaviors: retrieving and applying previously selected seats and movie selection from local storage upon page load, marking seats based on 'selectedSeats', setting the dropdown based on 'selectedMovieIndex', and handling the absence of local storage keys by defaulting to no selected seats and the first movie option 'The Big Lebowski ($10)'. R-4 contains multiple distinct behaviors: dynamically displaying selected seats count and total price, setting ticket price from 'movie-select' value, toggling 'selected' class on available seats, updating 'selected-count', calculating 'total-price' as product of selected seats and ticket price, decreasing count and total price upon deselection, updating total price while maintaining count when changing movies, and preventing selection of 'occupied' seats. R-5 contains multiple distinct behaviors: distinguishing between available, selected, and occupied seats through legends, displaying status legends including data-testid='seat-select', rendering occupied seats as non-interactive and clearly marked, allowing available seats to be clicked to toggle selection, and updating seat count and total price upon selection or deselection.
